seo.title: Zegna: AI-assisted clienteling (Zegna X) - about 45% of boutique sales (2023)
seo.meta_description: Zegna X, the AI clienteling tool built with Microsoft, accounts for about 45% of Zegna boutique sales and offers 49 billion made-to-measure combinations.
seo.resume_citable: Zegna X, the AI-assisted clienteling tool built with Microsoft, accounts for about 45% of revenue at Zegna boutiques and offers nearly 49 billion made-to-measure outfit combinations.

faq.q: What share of sales does Zegna X account for?
faq.a: About 45% of revenue at Zegna boutiques, according to the group as cited by Microsoft and the fashion press.

faq.q: What does Zegna X actually do?
faq.a: An advisor works with the client, through a 3D configurator, to compose made-to-measure outfits and pieces from about 49 billion combinations, delivered in under four weeks.

objectif_business: Extend Zegna's made-to-measure craftsmanship through a digital tool that helps advisors personalize outfits and made-to-measure pieces, and turn clienteling into a driver of retail revenue.
description: Zegna X pairs a sales advisor with a recommendation system built with Microsoft. A 3D configurator lets the client compose made-to-measure outfits and pieces from some 49 billion combinations of cuts and materials, with delivery within four weeks. The advisor engages the client one-to-one in store or over WhatsApp or WeChat, drawing on CRM data and purchase history. Launched at the Milan flagship by appointment in April 2023 with more than 2,300 customizable products, the tool was extended to other boutiques and then to zegna.com in 2024. Zegna allocated more than 5 million euros to the Zegna X ecosystem in 2022.
points_cles: AI-assisted clienteling with a 3D configurator and in-store recommendation.
Microsoft Azure, the Zegna X configurator, and the client CRM.
About 45 percent of boutique sales, about 49 billion made-to-measure combinations.
Evidence level B, living status confirmed.

resultats.metrique: Share of retail sales generated by Zegna X

niveau_preuve.justification: Microsoft customer story (technology partner) quantifying the 45% share of boutique sales, confirmed by specialized fashion press that repeats the same figure and the investment. Two concordant sources, named executive.

stack_technique.detail: Cloud foundation of the setup: CRM, data, analytics, and predictive analytics that feed the advisor's recommendations.
Composes made-to-measure outfits and pieces from about 49 billion combinations, delivered within four weeks.
Profile, purchase history, and preferences that personalize the suggestions; without this link, the tool falls back to a generic catalog.
One-to-one clienteling channels between the advisor and the client, alongside the store.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time during the client appointment; the catalog and style rules are updated each collection
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: In-store sales advisors, supported by the group's CRM and digital team
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The CRM client profile (purchase history, preferences, measurements). Without this link, the configurator does no more than a generic catalog and loses its clienteling effect.

etapes.detail: The advisor engages the client one-to-one in store or over WhatsApp/WeChat and opens their CRM record.
The 3D configurator proposes outfit combinations and made-to-measure options from the catalog and the client's preferences.
The advisor adjusts the proposals, confirms the made-to-measure order, and sets the delivery time (under four weeks).
Interactions and purchases flow back into the CRM to feed the next recommendations.

prerequis_data: structured product catalog with customization options
prerequis_orga: network of advisors trained in clienteling
made-to-measure supply chain able to hold a short lead time
digital/CRM team to maintain the tool
replication.premiere_etape: Connect the CRM to a product configurator in a pilot boutique and measure the basket of clients served one-to-one.

playbook.action: Unify the client CRM (history, preferences, measurements) and structure the catalog of customization options.
playbook.livrable: Usable client profile plus configurable catalog.

playbook.action: Build the configurator connected to the CRM and the catalog.
playbook.livrable: Tool usable in appointments by an advisor.

playbook.action: Train the advisors of a pilot boutique in tool-supported clienteling.
playbook.livrable: Pilot team autonomous on the tool.

playbook.action: Launch the pilot at the flagship by appointment and measure.
playbook.livrable: Read on average basket and share of assisted sales versus unserved clients.

playbook.action: Extend to the other boutiques and then to e-commerce.
playbook.livrable: Wider rollout with a CRM loop fed by each interaction.

replication.equipe: 1 retail digital PM + a dev team (configurator, CRM integrations) + trained sales advisors + a CRM/data team

statut_vivant.note: Zegna X is presented as a pillar of the group's clienteling strategy, extended from the flagship to the boutiques and e-commerce. The last public quantified confirmation dates from 2023-2024.

transposable_ue.note: Italian group, European rollout first. The configurator combines client data (CRM) and the product catalog. Explicit consent is needed to attach a client profile to the recommendations and to comply with GDPR on profiling.
